info.title: MemoryService
info.description:
Admin API for the on-prem Redis Agent Memory control plane.

Authentication: every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>` — a single static
operator token (see the on-prem deployment guide). This is distinct from the agent keys used by
the data plane. Operational endpoints (health, build-info) are served separately and are unauthenticated.

There is no per-store database, subscription, or endpoint binding (iteration 1 uses a single shared
store database), and embedding configuration is resolved server-side from deployment config rather
than supplied here.

get.description:
List the built-in sensitive-data detectors a store may select in its
`longTermMemoryExclusions.builtInDetectors` configuration.

On-prem has no console, so this is the only supported way for an operator to
discover which detector ids exist. Ids copied from documentation instead drift
from the catalog the server actually resolves, and a selection naming an id this
endpoint does not list is rejected on write.

Read-only reference data with no store scope: nothing here is enabled by
anything, and selecting a detector is a store configuration change. The catalog
is compiled into the binary rather than configured, so the same set is served on
on-prem and in the cloud.

A detector's matching technique is deliberately not exposed. Built-in detectors
are platform-owned and versioned server-side, so their implementations stay free
to evolve — and to be composite or non-regex — under a stable id.

BuiltInDetectorItem.description:
One selectable built-in detector. Carries no enabled flag: the catalog says what
may be selected, and the store's own configuration says what is active.

id.description:
The stable detector identifier, as accepted in a store's exclusions
configuration. Kebab-case, with a jurisdiction prefix where the detector is
jurisdiction-specific.

description.description:
What the detector matches, and what it deliberately does not — the catalog is
precision-first, so an operator choosing between detectors needs the
limitation as much as the capability.

BuiltInDetectorsConfig.description: Selection of platform built-in detectors for a store.

customMemoryTypes.description:
Custom memory types to register on the store. Optional; when omitted the
store uses only built-in memory types.

storeId.description: Store identifier (1-64 chars, alphanumeric and dashes). Generated IDs are 32-char UUIDs without dashes.

name.description: Identifies the detector wherever a match of it is reported.

CustomDetectorsConfig.description:
Customer-authored detectors for a store, stored inline. Evaluated together with
the built-in group as one flat set.

detectors.description:
At most 32. Names must be unique within the store and must not be a built-in
detector id, which a match would otherwise be indistinguishable from.

CustomExtractionStrategy.description: Extraction strategy for a custom memory type.

prompt.description: Prompt used to extract memories of this type from session events.

enabled.description: Whether the strategy is active. Defaults to true when omitted.

CustomField.description: A structured field within a custom memory type.

name.description: Field name. Letters, digits, underscores, and dashes; must start with a letter.

description.description: Human-readable description of the field (1-200 chars).

CustomFieldType.description:
Supported custom field data types. Mirrors the Context Engine
FieldDescription.type vocabulary exactly.

CustomMemoryType.description:
A custom memory type registered on a store: a named category of long-term
memory with its structured fields and, optionally, an extraction strategy.

name.description:
Unique type name within the store. Must not collide with built-in types
(semantic, episodic, message, session_summary_view).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this memory type captures (1-200 chars).

fields.description:
Structured fields that make up a record of this type. Optional; a type
with no fields accepts direct writes carrying no structured attributes.

ExtractionCadenceConfig.description: Cadence configuration for the extraction pipeline.

activeIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds between extraction runs while a session is active (60-600).

correlating a result with the detector generation that produced it. Not a

SummarizationConfig.description:
Configuration for session summarization.
When enabled, long sessions are periodically condensed into a running summary
while retaining the most recent events.

enabled.description: Whether summarization is enabled for this store

threshold.description: The threshold value that triggers summarization

retainCount.description: Number of most recent events to retain after each summarization cycle.

SummarizationTriggerStrategy.description:
Strategy that determines when summarization is triggered.
Additional strategies such as token_count can be added later.
